text:
Sam: Quick sync idea 1: support 'heterogeneous precision lanes' where a profile assigns bitwidths per operator (e.g. attn=fp8, ffn=int8, embed=4bit). intent: better cost/quality tradeoffs. Thoughts? :thinking:
Priya: good for SLOs. need a concrete definition of "acceptability" and an automated regression gate.
Marta: runtime constraints: profiles must be small, version-tagged, and attached at model load. suggest a compact JSON with op->bit mapping + fallback order. no per-request DB hits.
Jon: ops: must have per-account toggles, cost telemetry by lane, and an emergency fallback. silent regressions are the main risk.
Priya: metrics: emit a per-response deg-score, track perplexity delta, and sample golden comparisons nightly. use these for automated alerts.
Marta: sketch profile example:
`{"id":"het-lane-v1","model":"redwood-m4","ops":{"attn":"fp8","ffn":"int8","emb":"4bit"},"fallback":["fp8","int8","fp32"],"acceptability":"deg:0.03"}`
Sam: API surfaces: (a) named profile on endpoint configs, (b) "adaptive" mode where runtime chooses cheapest acceptable profile.
Jon: rollout: shadow -> canary -> ramp. add a global kill-switch that flips endpoints to a safe default. also SLO alerts on deg-score drift.
deploy-bot: Canary queued: branch=het-precision-lanes build=4852 -> env=canary.
Sam: I'll draft an RFC covering schema, runtime loader, fallback rules, telemetry, rollout, and console UX. tagging @Priya @Marta @Jon for review.
